intro: Armenian media focus on the TRIPP agreement debate, Ruben Vardanyan's legal case, Karen Aslanyan's wrestling world title, and domestic political developments. International coverage includes Norway and Finland's calls with Putin and Israel's election.

topics.title: TRIPP agreement debated ahead of peace treaty
topics.text: Foreign Minister Ararat Mirzoyan stated the TRIPP agreement can be implemented before a final peace treaty with Azerbaijan, a position the parliamentary speaker supported by rejecting opposition arguments linking the two. Opposition lawmakers and the ARF Bureau warn the deal poses risks to Armenia's sovereignty.

sources.title: TRIPP Agreement Poses Serious Risks to Armenia’s Sovereignty, Warns ARF Bureau Member
Opposition Lawmakers Criticize ‘Trump Route’ Deal With U.S.
TRIPP can be implemented before final peace treaty, foreign minister says
Speaker rejects opposition arguments linking TRIPP implementation to Armenia-Azerbaijan peace treaty
Armenia’s foreign minister says Trump Route can advance before peace treaty

topics.title: ANC-International report challenges Baku's case against Ruben Vardanyan
topics.text: A new report by ANC-International asserts that Azerbaijan's legal case against Ruben Vardanyan fails on its own record. The findings were highlighted by both Asbarez and the Armenian Weekly.

sources.title: Baku’s Case Against Ruben Vardanyan Fails on Its Own Record, New ANC-International Report Says
ANC-International releases report on Baku’s case against Ruben Vardanyan

topics.title: Armenian wrestler Karen Aslanyan wins world championship gold
topics.text: Karen Aslanyan was crowned World Champion after defeating an Azerbaijani opponent in the final. The victory was reported by Asbarez, ArmRadio, Armenpress, and News.am.

topics.title: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare calls with Putin
topics.text: The leaders of Norway and Finland held rare phone conversations with Russian President Vladimir Putin, followed by a call with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy. ArmRadio and Armenpress covered the diplomatic outreach.

sources.title: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare call with Putin
Leaders of Norway, Finland hold calls with Putin then Zelenskiy

topics.title: Opposition Strong Armenia party pushes for snap elections
topics.text: The leader of the opposition Strong Armenia party declared readiness for snap parliamentary elections at any time, describing recent local elections as the authorities' "wake" and predicting a political "funeral" in coming months. News.am reported the statements.

topics.title: Armenia and Netherlands expand economic cooperation
topics.text: Dutch Foreign Minister Caspar Veldkamp visited Armenia to explore opportunities for expanding flower exports and broader economic ties under a strategic partnership declaration. Armenpress covered the discussions on trade and market access.

sources.title: Dutch Foreign Minister explores opportunities to expand Armenian flower exports

topics.title: Domestic violence prevention legislation advances
topics.text: Interior Minister Vahe Ghazaryan presented the government's support for new legislation aimed at preventing domestic violence. Armenpress reported on the parliamentary initiative.
